messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — need short coverage for Thurs 10:30am and 2:00pm PST. Two interviews: SRE IC3 (onsite/hybrid) and ML Infra SWE2 (remote). I can lead 10:30 but need a debrief owner for 2:00. Please call out scribe + confirm recording consent.

Elena: I can lead 2:00 if someone can scribe. @Samir would you be able to scribe that slot? Quick rubric Q — should we use the usual weights or bump design for this role?

Samir: I can scribe 2:00. For rubric: people-ops default is 50/30/20 (system design / code / behavioral). If hiring manager wants a different split for ML Infra we can change for this req. Rubric link: https://redwood-internal/handbook/interviews/rubric (read-only)

Aisha: Candidate requested remote-only option and asked about recording. We need explicit consent — use this template when asking: 

```
Hi <Candidate>,
We record interviews for calibration. Do you consent to an internal recording for hiring team review only? Reply YES to confirm.
```

Maya: I can scribe 10:30. I will get consent from candidate before the session.

Priya: Awesome — @Elena thanks. @Aisha I'll send consent text now. Schedule snippet (please copy/paste into your calendars):

```
Thu 10:30 PST - SRE IC3 - on-site (Priya lead) - scribe: Maya
Thu 14:00 PST - ML Infra SWE2 - remote (Elena lead) - scribe: Samir
Optional 14:15 PST - Hiring manager quick sync (15m)
```

Priya: Debrief protocol (super terse):
- 10 min immediate notes in thread
- Fill rubric scores in the linked doc
- Capture any follow-ups as action items in candidate card
- Upload short bullet debrief to /interviews/debriefs/<candidate-id>

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Please complete candidate consent form at least 12 hours before the interview. Form: https://redwood-internal/forms/consent — automated notices will go out.

Elena: Hiring manager confirmed we should keep 50/30/20 for this round. Also can someone ping the candidate's take-home repo link? I don't have it in calendar.

Samir: I have the repo link, I'll DM the panel with the URL and quick review pointers. Also adding optional 2:15 manager sync to the calendar now.

Priya: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the calendar invites and the candidate card. :thumbsup:

Maya: Got it, will capture scribe notes and the recording consent before start.

Elena: Thanks — see you all Thursday.
